function.name: give_up
function.arguments: {"reason": "Last call reached. The red block is still on the table untouched (side and wrist views at step 478), the gripper reads 0.0162 = closed on empty air, and no lift or transport was ever achieved, so the goal cannot be completed within the remaining budget.", "hindsight": "Rig facts worth knowing at the start. (1) A move_to that does not change the gripper latch is truncated to 2-6 control steps and delivers only 4-20 mm of travel, while a move_to that toggles the gripper runs about 80 steps and delivers 30-65 mm, so every approach should bundle the position target with the gripper command and never waste a call on a pure position move. (2) The pads hang well below the reported eef frame: at eef z=0.93 the pads were still above the block top and even at z=0.848 the close missed, so descend to the z bound 0.80-0.82 before closing. (3) Gripper measurement 0.016 means fully closed on air, 0.98 fully open, only an intermediate value proves holding; a commanded target is not a measurement. (4) Front camera horizontal is world y, side camera horizontal is world x with the base at the right, so block and bowl, which shared nearly the same y, overlapped in the front view and were only separable in the side view; the wrist camera looks down and toward -x with image right near -y. (5) This seed: block near x=-0.19 y=+0.01, bowl further toward -x at about x=-0.28, yaw about -0.04 so the pads travel along world y. (6) Do not spend the first ten calls on camera calibration; go low early and use the wrist view for final centring."}
